stories.title: Iran war leads to historic closing of the Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: On day 12 of U.S.-Israeli war against Iran, we learn more about the importance of the shipping lane: the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Australia shelters 7 Iranian women's soccer team members, but 1 wants to go back
stories.summary: Australia says it's given asylum to seven members of the Iranian national women's soccer team, but one has asked to return to Iran.

stories.title: High up in an old-growth redwood, a condor couple appears to be tending to an egg
stories.summary: Scientists say a pair of condors are likely tending to an egg high up in a California redwood — the first time that's happened there in more than a century. A Yurok wildlife official gives an update.

stories.title: The U.S. men's sled hockey team seeks a 5th gold Winter Paralympic gold medal
stories.summary: The U.S. men's sled hockey team is going for a fifth gold medal at the Winter Paralympics in Milan-Cortina. The U.S. has had a stellar run. Part of the reason is because of a team in New Hampshire.

stories.title: Just in time for Easter, egg prices drop sharply
stories.summary: A year ago, eggs were the poster child for runaway grocery prices. But egg prices have fallen sharply in the last 12 months.

stories.title: Rebecca Gayheart Dane on caring for her late husband, Eric Dane, and synthetic voices
stories.summary: The wife of 'Grey's Anatomy' actor Eric Dane says caring for him gave her an "extra dose" of compassion for others.
